stories.title: ‘A new record for entertainment’: Grand Theft Auto VI sales hit $3.8bn on first day of release, developer says
stories.take: Rockstar says GTA VI took in $3.79 billion on day one — more than the entire box-office run of the highest-grossing film ever — on 32.5 million pre-release units.

stories.title: Google rolls out new search homepage with AI chat history and no search button
stories.take: Google's new search homepage drops the search button and leads with AI chat history — search is becoming a conversation first, a query box second.

stories.title: Anthropic goes public
stories.take: Anthropic is public now, and the protest at its own headquarters on day one says plenty about the tension between its safety mission and public-market pressure.

stories.title: Meta reconsiders 2030 net-zero goal amid record emissions from AI data centers
stories.take: Meta is re-evaluating its 2030 net-zero goal as AI data centers push its emissions to record levels — the AI buildout is colliding with every big tech climate pledge.

stories.title: Researcher plants 2m canaries into the AI supply chain. A privacy disaster surfaced.
stories.take: A researcher planted 2 million trackable secrets into the AI supply chain and watched user data leak at an alarming rate — what you paste into AI tools does not necessarily stay private.

stories.title: Bending Spoons buys Mailchimp for $3.68B
stories.take: Bending Spoons is buying Mailchimp for $3.68 billion — a steep discount from the roughly $12 billion Intuit paid in 2021.

stories.title: SpaceX's Starshield troubles in Ukraine could threaten its broader military business
stories.take: The incoming House chair is threatening SpaceX funding over changes to Starshield service in Ukraine — the fight could spill into SpaceX's broader military business.

stories.title: Why more brands are paying creators to make their ads
stories.take: Creator-led production is the fastest-growing slice of the influencer economy — brands are paying creators to make the ads themselves, not just appear in them.

stories.title: Canva's 'AI off switch' finally recognises the backlash from creatives
stories.take: Canva added an AI off switch, a direct nod to the creative backlash — expect other tools to be pushed toward the same opt-out.

stories.title: Sociable: Instagram adds Amazon affiliate links
stories.take: Instagram now lets creators add up to 30 shoppable Amazon products per Reel — the creator storefront moves deeper inside the feed.

stories.title: Walmart mulls role advertising will play in an agentic shopping world
stories.take: Walmart's ad business is still growing fast, but executives admit AI shopping agents are changing how people find products — and what an ad even is in that flow.

stories.title: How Taco Bell Turned a Golf Tournament Into Its Latest Entertainment Play
stories.take: Taco Bell turned a golf tournament into an entertainment play with Kevin Hart, an on-course drive-thru and a Peacock premiere — Live Más as a content platform, not just a menu.

stories.title: The Media RFP Is Quietly Becoming Obsolete ft. Bruce Williams
stories.take: The traditional media RFP is quietly going obsolete as fragmentation breaks the old buying process — and gets in the way of better consumer experiences.

stories.title: The best GTA 6 brand reactions, from Mercedes Benz to... Huggies?
stories.take: From Mercedes-Benz to Huggies, brands piled onto the GTA 6 launch — the ones that actually made an effort are the ones anyone remembers.

stories.title: Harden explodes for 51, passes Kobe for third-most 50-point games all-time
stories.take: James Harden dropped 51 to lift the Cavs over the Pacers — his 26th 50-point game, passing Kobe Bryant for third-most in NBA history.

stories.title: Lillard scores 33 points in Milwaukee return as Blazers beat Bucks
stories.take: Damian Lillard scored a season-high 33 in his first game back in Milwaukee since the Bucks waived him, leading Portland to a 124-114 win.

stories.title: Wemby debuts 'shunk,' part jump shot, part dunk done with reason
stories.take: Wembanyama has dunked so much he blistered his hand, so he invented the 'shunk' — part jump shot, part dunk — and it worked.

stories.title: Sources: Clips' Ingram expected to make season, team debut vs. Rockets
stories.take: Brandon Ingram, recovered from Achilles surgery, is expected to make his season and Clippers debut Monday against the Rockets.

stories.title: NBA injury updates: The latest on Tyrese Haliburton, Anthony Edwards, Kawhi Leonard, Dylan Harper, more
stories.take: The injury wave is the story of the season so far — the latest on Haliburton, Anthony Edwards, Kawhi Leonard and Dylan Harper in one place.

stories.title: Timberwolves, Grizzlies reportedly hope to move to Eastern Conference after expansion; who makes more sense?
stories.take: Minnesota and Memphis both reportedly want to move East after expansion — Minnesota has the competitive case, Memphis has the geography.

stories.title: 👀 What the first month has revealed about all 30 teams
stories.take: One month in, the biggest storyline for every team — who's real, who's hurt, and who's already in trouble.

stories.title: Gil, '24 AL Rookie of Year, cut loose by Yankees at MLB tender deadline
stories.take: The Yankees cut Luis Gil, the 2024 AL Rookie of the Year, at the tender deadline — he headlines 44 players who became free agents Friday.

stories.title: Dodgers acquire versatile infielder Lewis in trade with Twins
stories.take: The Dodgers landed former No. 1 pick Royce Lewis from the Twins, filling their need for a versatile right-handed bat to replace Miguel Rojas.

stories.title: Sources: Tigers, right-hander Melton agree to 6-year, $46.5M extension
stories.take: Detroit locked up Troy Melton — 8-5 with a 2.76 ERA in 20 starts — on a six-year, $46.5 million extension.

stories.title: Padres bring back slugger Sheets with 3-year deal
stories.take: Gavin Sheets is staying in San Diego on a three-year deal, keeping a productive bat in the middle of the Padres' order.

stories.title: Ohtani extends deal with New Balance for remainder of playing career
stories.take: Shohei Ohtani extended his New Balance deal through the rest of his playing career — his off-field empire keeps pace with his on-field one.

stories.title: Sources: Loáisiga back to Bronx after agreeing to 2-year deal
stories.take: Jonathan Loáisiga is returning to the Yankees on a two-year deal with a club option for 2029, reuniting after a season apart.

stories.title: MLB CBA negotiations timeline: League, MLBPA continue brawling over salary cap as Dec. 1 deadline nears
stories.take: League and union are still brawling over a salary cap with the Dec. 1 deadline nearing — a work stoppage remains a real possibility.

stories.title: Trump turns White House press conference into a 2028 succession audition
stories.take: Trump put Vance and Rubio through their paces as potential successors in a wide-ranging presser — with Stephen Miller unexpectedly stealing the spotlight.

stories.title: Trump threatens ‘tremendous penalties’ for US tech firms that build datacenters abroad
stories.take: Trump threatened tremendous penalties for U.S. tech firms that build data centers abroad, saying he has fantastic relationships with Putin and Xi in the same sprawling press conference.

stories.title: NATO calls Russian missiles landing in Poland a 'grave violation' of airspace
stories.take: Two Russian missiles and a suspected drone came down in Poland — NATO called it a grave violation, and Poland's prime minister called it a likely provocation timed to Western military exercises.

stories.title: S&P 500 sinks 3.7% and the Nasdaq composite goes negative for the year
stories.take: The S&P 500 sank 3.7% and the Nasdaq went negative for the year — the same AI stocks that powered the rally are now driving the slide.

stories.title: Rights groups urge sanctions after ICJ finds Myanmar guilty of genocide against Rohingya
stories.take: The ICJ found Myanmar guilty of genocide against the Rohingya and ordered reparations and a safe return for those who fled — rights groups now want sanctions, since the court can't enforce its own ruling.

stories.title: Republican senator blocks Trump cyber nominee over January 6 denial
stories.take: Sen. Thom Tillis blocked Trump's CISA nominee after the nominee said of January 6, 'I don't believe it was an attack' — a rare Republican break, from a senator on his way out.

stories.title: Cop31 talks go into overtime as debate rages over lack of fossil fuels in draft deal
stories.take: COP31 ran into overtime with fossil fuels missing from the draft deal — African ministers said they didn't come to beg, and civil society groups are calling it the worst COP ever.

stories.title: Palisades arson retrial ends with conviction of man accused of sparking deadly wildfire
stories.take: A federal jury convicted Jonathan Rinderknecht of sparking the deadly Palisades fire — the retrial ended in conviction after the first jury deadlocked 10-2 for acquittal.

stories.title: California adds 47,000 jobs in October, dropping unemployment rate to lowest in three years
stories.take: California added 47,000 jobs in October and unemployment fell to its lowest level in three years — a rare piece of clean economic good news for the state.

stories.title: Atmospheric river dumps rain on Southern California, breaking decades-old records
stories.take: Thursday's atmospheric river broke decades-old rainfall records across Southern California — a preview of a wetter-than-normal winter ahead.

stories.title: California just elected its most diverse group of lawmakers yet
stories.take: California's new statehouse is its most diverse ever — for the first time, women will hold as many seats as men, with a string of firsts across Congress and the governor's office too.

stories.title: L.A. rattled by magnitude 4.2 earthquake felt over a wide area
stories.take: A magnitude 4.2 earthquake centered near Commerce rattled the Los Angeles area Friday morning, felt widely across the basin.

stories.title: D.A. won't charge LAPD officer who shot mentally ill man in family's Koreatown apartment
stories.take: The L.A. County D.A. won't charge the LAPD officer who killed Yong Yang, a mentally ill man shot inside his family's Koreatown apartment in 2024.

stories.title: ‘A source of inspiration’: California celebrates the late civil rights icon Dolores Huerta
stories.take: Hundreds gathered for a public vigil and celebration of life for Dolores Huerta, the civil rights icon and United Farm Workers co-founder.

stories.title: The Week the Wheels Came Off the AI Trade
stories.take: Nasdaq fell more than 5% Friday and more than 10% for the week, losing about $4 trillion and turning negative for the year; the S&P and Dow entered correction • Anthropic fell more than 9% a day after its record-breaking IPO — doubts now hang over Nvidia's role financing the AI ecosystem, rising rates and the data-center backlash • Trump announced a 'tremendous tax' on U.S. companies that build data centers overseas and floated AI guardrails with China • Ten years after Brexit, UK Prime Minister Andy Burnham is floating rejoining the EU

stories.title: Just how much have energy costs raised core inflation?
stories.take: The answer: the Dallas Fed estimates 0.2 to 0.6 percentage points of core PCE (3.1% last month) is energy pass-through — diesel and transport costs work into everything, and firms pass them on while consumers keep spending • Friday rout: Dow −949, Nasdaq −5.3%, S&P −3.7%; the panel calls the AI selloff a reckoning that was due, not yet a clean bubble pop • Squeezed consumers still lifted October retail sales almost 7%, so retailers are pulling Black Friday earlier to grab share of wallet • Cheap salmon may be ending: farmed production in Norway and Chile has hit ecological limits and global output is down about 3%

stories.title: Anthropic’s Moment of Truth, Jensen in Limbo, Apple’s AI Agent
stories.take: Anthropic IPO verdict: priced at $83, popped to $114, closed day one up 17%, then fell about 10% — a raging success for the company and its 4,000-plus new millionaires, but it did not save the market and answered nothing about AI's business model • Nvidia is down 37% in a month and the board will not bring Jensen Huang back; the deeper questions are how its revenue was generated and reported China chip ties • OpenAI's road got harder: Anthropic drained the capital pool, and 'the bank of Nvidia is closed' • Bloomberg says Apple's own autonomous AI agent is in development — but Siri still fumbles music requests while Alexa Plus pulls ahead

stories.title: Adjusting for Credit Risk: Masters In Business with David Eichhorn
stories.take: NISA CEO David Eichhorn — $483 billion, 100% employee-owned — argues most fixed income 'alpha' is long-credit beta in disguise: regress out the credit exposure and it shrinks or vanishes • Real alpha is breadth: hundreds of small uncorrelated bets, including trading rich versus cheap bonds of the same issuer for the same credit risk • Private credit loans earn about a 3% illiquidity premium unlevered, but vehicle leverage at roughly SOFR+200 plus high fees destroys all of it — own it unlevered and lever cheaply elsewhere; he opposes private credit in 401(k)s • 30-year TIPS near 3.5% real are 'extraordinarily attractive,' and pension buyouts shifting risk to insurers worry him

stories.title: Culver City ends contract with Flock Safety, LA Phil taps Silvana Estrada for Creative Chair of Latin Music, Turkey or no turkey— Afternoon Edition
stories.take: Culver City voted to end its Flock Safety surveillance contract over privacy and immigration-enforcement concerns; the cameras are deactivated immediately and will be removed • Silvana Estrada, fresh off a Latin Grammy for 'Dime,' is the LA Phil's new Creative Chair of Latin Music • Thanksgiving, Team Turkey vs. Team No Turkey: one chef's family serves three meats instead of a bird nobody liked, while Gwen's head butcher says turkey is just cooked wrong — brine it, use a probe thermometer, pull it 10 degrees early and rest 20 to 30 minutes
